messages.author: 94835dd4e822b53e
messages.subject: LAI Variable in Microclimate Model
parts:
Hi Mike/All,

I have noticed that in some cases a project uses a static LAI that is an average or approximation for the site and others pull it specifically for each site. I am running a microclimate and ectotherm model across a desert species' entire range where LAI should be relatively low and was wondering how much of an effect LAI (which should be at least relatively similar across the species range) has on the outputs of the microclimate model, if it should be modeled on a pixel by pixel basis or if having an across range average is appropriate in this case?

Best,

Connor
--
M.S. Biology, Austin Peay State University 2022
B.S. Wildlife and Fisheries Ecology and Conservation & GIS Technologies.

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: LAI Variable in Microclimate Model
parts:
Hi Connor,
There are two LAI inputs - one for the soil moisture modelling aspect of the microclimate model but also one that goes into the microclima radiation calculation. I suspect in your case it would not matter too much if you just kept it at the default value. But the best thing to do is a sensitivity analysis and see how much it affects your predictions. To be honest, I haven't really played around with it too much thus far.
All the best,
Mike

messages.author: 2bcecdd9c0443e65
messages.subject: Re: LAI Variable in Microclimate Model
parts:
If I may be able to pitch in a bit: from my experience using the NMR microclimate model and interfacing with microclima, and from discussions with Ilya, for the microclima sides of things LAI is one of the more important parameters for determining amount of intercepted downwelling radiation. But my hunch would be the same, that for a low veg desert system you probably don’t need to worry too much. I can’t recall off the top of my head if it’s been built into microclima functions/calls to these functions via micro_global or micro_era5, but in the microclimc package there are lists of default veg parameters for a set of categorical habitat types (eg for you could be barren or short grassland) that would provide estimates of LAI. You can take a look at these via microclimc::LAIfromhabitat(), or microctools::LAIfromhabitat (I’m currently in the field and don’t immediately recall which one).

Hope this helps, 
Dave
